intro: Field Marshal Snowfall is a dwarven military officer stationed in Ironforge's Military Ward to coordinate the Alliance war effort against the rising silithid threat. Facing an ancient evil stirring in the southern sands of Silithus, he oversees the massive logistical drive required to equip the allied armies. Snowfall tracks donated raw materials and rewards those who aid the realm's preparation for war.

p: Standing watch in Ironforge's Military Ward, Field Marshal Snowfall serves as the central coordinator for the Alliance's mobilization against Ahn'Qiraj. He views the brewing conflict not merely as a border skirmish, but as a critical fight against an ancient enemy hostile to all creations of the Titans. Snowfall oversees staggering stockpiles of supplies—millions of bandages, tons of metal bars, leathers, herbs, and rations gathered by adventurers—ensuring that Alliance forces will be armed, armored, and fed when the march south to Silithus begins.

Mobilizing an entire faction requires coordination between blacksmiths, gathers, cooks, and soldiers across every Alliance territory. Snowfall monitors each stage of this immense operation, accepting commendation signets and offering supply requisitions to volunteers. Once the required war supplies are fully gathered across both factions, the stockpiles are packed and hauled south to Cenarion Hold, readying the grand assault against the insectoid swarms and the Old God lurking behind the Scarab Wall.
